Which of your products is best for that, and why is it a good fit?
Message from Flo 🩸:
If your main goal is to try something high-confidence (and covered by the first-pair risk-free option), I’d recommend starting with Leakproof Underwear—then choosing the absorbency and silhouette that match your needs. 
A couple strong “quality-first” picks, depending on how you’ll use them: 
Super Leakproof Cotton Underwear: Designed for heavy days and overnight protection, and it absorbs about six super tampons’ worth of liquid without added bulk. It’s made from breathable pre-shrunk cotton with a touch of stretch, and uses an innovative floating liner for leak coverage from every angle.
Super Leakproof® Dream Short (overnight): Built for overnight leakproof protection with a supportive boxer-short silhouette, an extra-long absorbent liner, and patented 360 LeakSeal™ technology to help lock in leaks from every angle.
SuperPlus Leakproof® Dream Short (maximum overnight): This has the longest and most absorbent leakproof liner with full front-to-back coverage from waistband to waistband, designed for heavy periods, postpartum flow, and overnight bladder leaks.
If you want a personalized match (based on what you’re using it for and your preferred underwear silhouette), you can take the Leakproof Underwear Quiz.
